## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass: `python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests`, and new behavior has a test
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, Developer Certificate of Origin)
- [ ] A verdict change cites its primary source and adds a CORRECTIONS.md entry
- [ ] No names or formats listed in STABILITY.md are removed or renamed
- [ ] No new network access at classification or report time, no telemetry
- [ ] No unredacted scan output, hostnames or customer data in the change or this description
